fact: The World Bank's technical note for the Botswana HEPRR project costs the EMR at US$1.531 million within a US$13.1 million IBRD-financed sub-component on information systems and digitalisation, which is to digitise medical records through the EMR and a shared health record and link the EMR to the health information exchange.
title: Botswana Health Emergency Preparedness, Response and Resilience (HEPRR) Project (P510190): Technical Note
